verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee publishes a detailed API reference listing parameters with types and defaults (e.g. extract_rules, ai_query, premium_proxy), plus copy-ready request examples such as JS scenario JSON and an llms.txt docs index. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive playground or in-browser runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404. missing for 10: interactive 'try it' API console, in-browser runnable examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
